entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, it will not open unless our skills are[n]acknowledged...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We need information on this floor.[n]Let's go to the counter first.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We might even be able to get some[n]coins there!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We're going to the manager's floor,[n]correct? It's not this way.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wait, I sense a Shadow beyond this door!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It may be the one from earlier. Let's go[n]beat the crap outta him if you're ready!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The ruler of this Palace is not only the[n]casino's manager, but she's its number[n]one player too.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No matter what methods we use, we must[n]emerge victorious here... for justice.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Joker, we should look around here[n]a little more.
